managePayments.state.ready.body: Your Stripe account is connected and can take payments.

managePayments.keyMismatch.title: Stripe keys do not match
managePayments.keyMismatch.body: This site’s server uses a {server, select, live {live} other {test}} Stripe key, while the browser version was built with a key that is {browser, select, live {live} other {test}}. Card payment would fail at the moment a customer tries to pay, so setting up Stripe is blocked until the keys match.
managePayments.keyMismatch.fix: Both keys must be set for the same environment, and the site rebuilt afterwards — the public (publishable) key is built in at build time, the secret key is read on every request.
managePayments.permission.title: Only the food truck’s owner can set up payments

manageWhatsApp.preview.examples.menu: What do you have on the menu?
manageWhatsApp.preview.noReplyWhy: That looks like spam, a booking request or something unrelated, so the auto-reply stays quiet.
manageWhatsApp.preview.footnote: Replies are generated by AI, differ slightly each time and can sometimes be wrong.

manageWhatsApp.notice.sdkBlocked: Meta’s login script could not load. The usual cause is an ad blocker or tracking protection.
manageWhatsApp.notice.setupFailed: Setup can’t be completed. Nothing was changed.
manageWhatsApp.notice.metaError: Meta reported a problem during setup. Nothing was changed. Try again and get in touch if this keeps happening.
manageWhatsApp.notice.closed: Setup was closed before it finished. Nothing was changed — press “Set up” to try again.
manageWhatsApp.notice.disconnectedUnreac: The connection to WhatsApp is cut. We couldn’t contact Meta to remove access. Remove HatchGrab in WhatsApp Business → Settings → Account → Business Platform.

manageWhatsApp.card.title: Auto-replies
manageWhatsApp.card.description: Answer customer questions automatically on social media, using your menu and schedule.
manageWhatsApp.card.requiresAccount: A WhatsApp Business account is needed.
manageWhatsApp.card.popupInstruction: A Facebook window will open to connect your WhatsApp Business account. If nothing appears, allow pop-ups for hatchgrab.com in your browser, then press “Set up” again.
manageWhatsApp.card.switchedOff: WhatsApp auto-replies are switched off for your food truck.
manageWhatsApp.card.expiring: Your WhatsApp connection needs renewing soon. Press “Reconnect” to keep auto-replies working.
manageWhatsApp.card.instagram: Auto-replies to Instagram direct messages. A professional Instagram account will be needed.
manageWhatsApp.card.messenger: Auto-replies on Facebook Messenger. A Facebook Page will be needed.
manageWhatsApp.blocked.title: Your replies are not being delivered
manageWhatsApp.blocked.body: WhatsApp is refusing to send your automatic replies because of a billing problem on your WhatsApp Business account. Customers can still message you and you will still see everything they send — but they are not getting a reply.
manageWhatsApp.blocked.fix: You pay WhatsApp directly for these messages, so this is fixed in WhatsApp Manager. <link>Check your payment method</link>
manageWhatsApp.limit.heading: Auto-replies
manageWhatsApp.limit.label: Monthly limit
manageWhatsApp.limit.usage: Used: {used, number} of {limit, number} · starts again {date}
manageWhatsApp.limit.perCustomer: Most replies per customer in 24 hours: {n}; after that one message saying you will reply personally.
manageWhatsApp.limit.emailAt: Replies pause when you reach the limit. We will email you at 80% and 100%.
manageWhatsApp.billing.heading: Billing
manageWhatsApp.billing.summary: Meta, not HatchGrab, bills your WhatsApp account for replies. From {from}, number of free replies a month: {free, number}. Correct on {checked}; for changes check <link>Meta’s prices</link>.
manageWhatsApp.billing.chargesTitle: WhatsApp replies are charged by Meta, not HatchGrab.
manageWhatsApp.billing.chargesBody: Each reply HatchGrab sends for you is billed by Meta to your WhatsApp Business account. From {from}, Meta includes free replies a month per phone number (number: {free, number}); after that each reply is charged at Meta’s price. Replies you send yourself from the WhatsApp Business app are not charged. Meta sets these prices and may change them. <link>See Meta’s prices</link>
manageWhatsApp.billing.addPaymentInManag: Add a payment method in WhatsApp Manager
manageWhatsApp.billing.aboveMissing: Your limit is above Meta’s free replies ({free, number}). Without a payment method, Meta will stop all replies when those are used.
manageWhatsApp.billing.aboveGeneral: Your limit is above Meta’s free replies ({free, number}). Replies beyond that need a payment method on your WhatsApp account; without one, Meta stops all replies when the free ones are used.
manageWhatsApp.disconnect.title: Disconnect from WhatsApp?
manageWhatsApp.disconnect.body: Auto-replies stop immediately and HatchGrab loses access to your WhatsApp account. Your number keeps working in the WhatsApp Business app. To remove HatchGrab completely, also open WhatsApp Business → Settings → Account → Business Platform.
manageWhatsApp.signup.partial: We linked your WhatsApp Business account but couldn’t complete the connection. Everything is fine on your side — get in touch and we will finish it.
manageWhatsApp.signup.noNumber: Your WhatsApp Business account is linked, but no phone number came back. Press “Reconnect” and finish the number step.
manageWhatsApp.signup.needsRegistering: Your account is linked, but we must register this number before replies can start. Contact support — your setup is saved, don’t run it again.
manageWhatsApp.signup.registerRefused: Your account is linked, but Meta would not register the number. Your setup is saved — contact support instead of running it again.
manageWhatsApp.signup.deliveryRefused: Your account is linked, but Meta would not turn on message delivery. Your setup is saved — contact support instead of running it again.
manageWhatsApp.signup.numberTaken: That WhatsApp number is already connected to another HatchGrab account. One number can only answer for one food truck. Contact support and we will move it.
manageWhatsApp.signup.saveIncomplete: Almost done — we couldn’t finish saving. Your setup is saved; contact support instead of running it again.
manageWhatsApp.signup.connected: WhatsApp is connected. Auto-replies will start answering messages sent to this number.

customDomain.confirm.heading: Have a look, then confirm to us that everything is right
customDomain.confirm.checkTimes: Check the dates and times are right.
customDomain.confirm.problemLine: Tell us what you see and we will look.
customDomain.confirmed.heading: Thanks — everything is noted.
customDomain.confirmed.body: You don’t need to do anything else.
customDomain.turnOff.heading: Turn off your own web address?

customDomain.turnOff.reAdd: If you will set this up again later, leave the line you added at the company that runs your web address. If not, ask them to remove it.
customDomain.turnOff.failed: We couldn’t turn that off right now. Nothing has changed — your address still works. Try again soon.
customDomain.wizard.resumeFailedBody: Nothing has changed. Try again soon.
customDomain.address.intro: Your schedule gets its own web address.
customDomain.address.question: What is your web address?
customDomain.address.hint: The one people already use to find you.
customDomain.address.noChange: Your website doesn’t change — you just add a link to the new address.
customDomain.address.notSetUp: We have not set this up.
customDomain.address.restricted: Whoever runs your web address must allow us to set up the padlock — the little lock customers see beside the address. Until they add us, the padlock won’t appear, so we stopped rather than leave you waiting. Ask them to add us, then try again.
customDomain.address.blocked: Your web address currently blocks the padlock completely. Whoever runs it must allow it before this can work. Ask them to change that, then try again.
customDomain.address.elsewhere: Something already answers on that address. Send the message from the next screen to whoever runs it — they will know what to do.
customDomain.address.provider: Your web address is run by: {provider}. We will show you where to go.
customDomain.address.provisionFailed: We couldn’t set up that address.
customDomain.address.couldNotBeSetUp: That address could not be set up.
customDomain.apex.empty: Type the address you want to use.
customDomain.apex.not_a_domain: That doesn’t look like a web address.
customDomain.apex.unparseable: We couldn’t read that as a web address. Check how it is spelt and try again.
customDomain.apex.apex: {host} is the address of your whole website. If you point it at us, your website will be replaced by this page. Instead, put a word in front of it — for example dogadaji.{host} (events.{host}).
customDomain.apex.too_deep: That address has too many parts. Something like dogadaji.{domain} (events.{domain}) works best.
customDomain.record.addAt: Add this at the service provider {provider}
customDomain.record.guide: The service provider {provider}’s guide to this
customDomain.record.addAtSave: Add this at the service provider {provider} and save.
customDomain.record.addSomewhere: Add this where your web address is run, and save.
customDomain.record.hintWord: Just this word, not the whole address.
customDomain.record.timing: It usually starts working within an hour, though it can take longer. You don’t need to keep this page open.
customDomain.record.someoneElse: Someone else runs your web address?
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.open: Open your web address, then “DNS” and “Records”.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.add: Select “Add record”, then pick “CNAME” as the “Type”.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.name: Enter the first value below in “Name”.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.value: Enter the second value below in “Target”.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.proxy: Set “Proxy status” to “DNS only” — the cloud beside it must be grey, not orange.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.caveat: If the cloud stays orange, the padlock will never appear and nothing will tell you why.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.open: Open “Domain Portfolio” and choose your web address.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.add: Select “Add New Record”, then pick “CNAME” from the “Type” menu.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.name: Enter the first value below in “Name”.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.value: Enter the second value below in “Value”.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.save: Leave “TTL” as it is and select “Save”.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.caveat: If you added more than one record at once, the button says “Save All Records”.
customDomain.providers.123reg.signIn: Sign in to the “123 Reg Control Panel”.
customDomain.providers.123reg.manage: Beside “Domains”, select “Manage All”, then choose your web address.
customDomain.providers.123reg.name: Enter the first value below in “Name”.
customDomain.providers.123reg.value: Enter the second value below in “Value” and add a full stop to its end.
customDomain.providers.123reg.caveat: 123 Reg needs a full stop at the end of the second value, otherwise it won’t work.
customDomain.providers.wix.open: Open “Domains”, then click the “Domain Actions” icon beside your web address.
customDomain.providers.wix.add: In the “CNAME (Aliases)” section, click “+ Add Record”, then “Got it”.
customDomain.providers.wix.name: Enter the first value below in “Host Name”.
customDomain.providers.wix.value: Enter the second value below in “Value”.
customDomain.providers.wix.save: Click “Save”, then “Save Changes” in the pop-up.
customDomain.providers.wix.caveat: If your web address only points at Wix and is not registered with it, Wix can’t make this change — whoever the address is registered with has to.
